testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.tenancy.PrivilegeEscalationTests

testcase.name: tenant level - nobody adds itself to a tenant or changes its own tenant role, not even a system admin()
a project owner and a plain member cannot promote themselves, but an admin can promote someone else()
a workspace admin cannot re-add or promote itself, and cannot add itself to a project it is not in()
a system admin onboards OTHER people through tenant-scoped provisioning, never through a workspace it is not a member of()
a system admin who is a member cannot raise its own workspace or project role()
a system admin cannot add itself to a workspace it does not belong to (R-08)()
a tenant admin has no way into the workspaces of its tenant through the member API()
